use_case: Tailgating detection: counts people passing each turnstile lane against badge reads and alerts the security console with a clip
business_owner: Commercial Property director of security operations
vendor_or_model: Access control and video platform vendor (computer-vision person-detection model)
data_categories: Lobby video; turnstile badge events; alert clips (no face templates; no identity inferred)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (advisory alerts); re-tier to Safety/CI if alerts drive automatic turnstile or door actions
human_in_the_loop: Console officer reviews the clip and badge record before any action; only a courteous badge check is allowed; accessible-lane alerts are review-only
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); state law: video is excluded from biometric data under Fla. Stat. 501.702 (worked example); keep audio disabled (Fla. Stat. 934.03 worked example)
status: In production (vendor-enabled at 23 office properties); continued with conditions due 2026-12-31

use_case: Face verification: compares a live face capture at the turnstile with the enrolled template and denies entry on a mismatch
business_owner: Commercial Property director of security operations
vendor_or_model: Access control and video platform vendor (face recognition model)
data_categories: Face templates from enrollment photos and live captures (treated as biometric data)
human_in_the_loop: Vendor default was automatic denial; since 2026-08-31 a mismatch only alerts a guard, who checks the badge
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 and the FTC biometric policy statement; Fla. Stat. 501.171 (treated as biometric personal information; the 501.702 exclusion for data generated from video makes this unsettled; counsel to confirm); other states' biometric laws where enrollees reside (counsel to map)
status: Pilot at 2 Florida office towers (about 1,900 opt-in enrollees); expansion prohibited; council decision due 2026-11-30

use_case: BAS optimization: a SaaS service reads trend data and writes HVAC setpoints automatically to save energy
vendor_or_model: BAS optimization SaaS vendor (machine learning model)
data_categories: BAS trend data; setpoints; occupancy schedules (no personal information)
human_in_the_loop: Writes within RBOC-defined setpoint ranges; RBOC can override; no human approval per change
applicable_laws: CISA CPG 2.0 goals 1.E and 3.P (voluntary, adopted); lease HVAC service terms; NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 (guidance)
status: In production at 41 buildings (including 4 managed buildings); continued with conditions; no new buildings until conditions met

use_case: Jobsite safety analytics: detects missing hard hats, vests, and fall protection in jobsite camera video
data_categories: Jobsite video of workers and subcontractor staff
consequential_decision_category: None directly; re-tier to Employment if alerts are used for discipline
human_in_the_loop: Safety manager reviews alerts for coaching; no automated discipline
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5; federal anti-discrimination law (Title VII) if alerts feed employment decisions; state recording laws (keep audio off)
status: In production at 60 jobsites; coaching-only rule effective 2026-10-01

use_case: AI estimating and bid assistant: drafts quantity takeoffs and estimates from drawings and historical costs
vendor_or_model: Estimating SaaS vendor (generative model, enterprise tenant)
data_categories: Bid documents; drawings; historical costs; FCI if federal bids are uploaded
human_in_the_loop: Estimators review every estimate; bids approved by preconstruction leads
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(iii) (external systems); DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(2) (FCI and CUI only on systems with CMMC status); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor terms)
status: In production for commercial bids; federal uploads blocked by 2026-11-30 (POAM-017)

use_case: Revenue management: recommends room rates by date, room type, and channel
data_categories: Booking history; competitor public rates; demand forecasts (no guest-level data)
human_in_the_loop: Revenue managers approve rate strategies; daily rates publish automatically within approved bands
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 464.2 (total price including mandatory fees in every display); FTC Act Section 5
status: In production at 88 hotels; channel feed fix for total price due 2026-12-31

use_case: Guest messaging assistant: answers guest questions by text and chat and handles simple requests using reservation data
data_categories: Guest names, reservation details, and messages
human_in_the_loop: Safety, billing disputes, and accessibility requests hand off to staff; guests are told they are messaging an AI assistant
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5; 16 CFR 464.2 (total price in answers); FTC AI accuracy policy statement is proposed only (not final)
status: In production at 52 hotels; guardrail retest due 2026-12-31

use_case: Hourly hiring screening: ranks applicants for hotel hourly roles and recommends who to interview
human_in_the_loop: Recruiters see every application; low-ranked applicants are not rejected without a recruiter review (from 2026-10-01)
applicable_laws: Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, 7200 et seq. (ADMT for the 2 California hotels; compliance by 2027-01-01); Title VII (disparate impact; 29 CFR 1607.4(D) four-fifths rule as a screening test); FTC Act Section 5
status: In production (about 31,000 applicants a year); continued with conditions; California use decision due 2026-11-30
